text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Is this a theater prop?! It's so<n>detailed!

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thanks! I made it. If there's<n>one thing I'm
good at, it's detailed<n>handiwork like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Oh, there's a mini bed, too.

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text:
They're all deeply sentimental pieces,<n>but the
clubroom will overflow if we<n>keep everything.
That's why I'm<n>trying to decide what to throw out.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sure is a lotta stuff. Oh, I<n>know! How's
about I give you a<n>hand?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, I'm gonna help her out, so<n>you can go on
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nah, I'll help, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? You will?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But I've got a favor to ask in<n>return.

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text: And what's that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaaand done and dusted!<n>Everything's tidied up!

text_block_list.name: Theater Club Student
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, you two! I<n>appreciate your help.
And as<n>promised, here's what you wanted,<n>Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's the mini bed from before... Is<n>that what you
asked for in exchange<n>for helping out?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! I mean, you're pretty small,<n>but won't it
be hard to sleep if you're<n>all crammed into that
thing?! Just the<n>thought is painful!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna be the one sleeping in<n>it, bonehead!
...I'm out of here.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Wait for me, Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the academy gate in the<n>evening, I
notice Winning Ticket<n>looking around the area
restlessly.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I could have sworn I spotted Taishin<n>just now, but
she disappeared. I<n>wonder where she's run off to...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, there she is! Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I hope it's around right now...

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Mew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, there you are. Still feeling down?<n>Silly fluff ball.
Here, I got you a new<n>bed.

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Mraow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why're you rubbing all over me?<n>Trying to butter
me up? Anyway, this<n>should be a good replacement
for that<n>cushion of yours.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin watches over the kitten<n>with a gentle
look in her eyes as it<n>makes itself comfortable on
the bed.
choice_data_list: Is that a present for the cat?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Right as I'm about to tell Winning<n>Ticket we should
head back to the<n>academy...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! That's so touchiiing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin! I can't believe you helped<n>out the theater
club so you could get a<n>present for that little kitten!
You're<n>such a kind soul!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Sh-shut it! And quit being a gross<n>stalker, seriously!
Get lost!

text_block_list.name: Black Kitten
text_block_list.text: Hiss!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Don't leave, kitty! C'mere!<n>There's nothing
to be afraid of!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It ran away because of you and your<n>megaphone
mouth! Quiet down! Or<n>better yet—get out of here!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I'm sorry, kitty! I'll be quiet, so<n>please come
back!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're still yelling!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The kitten watches from a distance<n>as the two flail
around and argue. I<n>see what I imagine is equal
parts<n>bewilderment and amusement in its
expression.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How long have you guys been<n>there?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Hic! I-I'm sooo tooouuuched!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, keep it down! You'll scare the<n>cat away.
Geez!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This shrine here runs a community<n>cat program,
and they've been taking<n>care of this little one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Its favorite cushion was all beat up,<n>so it had
nothing to sleep on. Looked<n>pretty down about it
too, so... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-waaaaah! I had no idea there was<n>such a sad
story behind all this!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta tell everyone about this<n>touching tale!
Hold on, I'm gonna go<n>spread the word back at the
academy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What?! Don't do that, Ticket! Hey!<n>Come back
here, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin rushes after Winning<n>Ticket in a huff
while the kitten curls<n>up into a satisfied little ball on
its new<n>bed.
